purpose: Derive an imported project's complete specialist campaign from typed project evidence instead of a fixed product roster.
planning_rule: The Controller derives applicable roles, priority, dependency order, Platform ownership, resource limits, and acceptance gates from goals, architecture, features, environments, hardware, standards, evidence, and unresolved unknowns. A fixed project roster is forbidden.
wave_rule: At most six cognitive lanes run concurrently. Every wave passes specialist audit and repair, Platform review/test/integration, Central integration, and independent re-audit before dependent work advances.

spawner_boundary.rule: The Controller requests typed roles with exact priority, dependency, scope, admission, custody, and return-route bindings. The Agent Spawner validates the lifecycle request and creates or archives the exact governed agent; it does not choose priorities, plan waves, direct work, supervise progress, evaluate quality, accept results, or route repairs.
spawner_boundary.incomplete_blocks: Return a typed non-provisioning result to the requester and never create an agent from an incomplete lifecycle request.
spawner_boundary.background_rule: The Spawner performs no background wave preparation or campaign scheduling; it acts on explicit lifecycle requests.
spawner_boundary.invalidation_rule: The requesting authority supplies current invalidation and admission evidence; the Spawner rejects stale bindings without repairing or evaluating them.
spawner_boundary.incremental_library_rule: Library construction and evaluation occur outside the Spawner lifecycle operation. The Spawner consumes only the resulting exact authorized request and receipts.

automatic_continuation.routine_transition: Start the next eligible transition before ending the Controller turn.
automatic_continuation.no_progress: Inspect the exact blocker, run one bounded recovery, verify the result, and continue unaffected work.
automatic_continuation.owner_review: Only direct protected interaction, destructive or irreversible user-work risk, material unexpected cost/legal/safety risk, production/public release, or route-changing equal-authority conflict requires owner review.

zero_trace_rule: Planning and orchestration state remains in the external control plane. Product source receives no AgentOS artifacts.
